summary: Iteration 5 - School Profile (my-school) end-to-end tested. Added /app/backend/tests/test_my_school.py with 14 pytest tests covering: GET /api/my-school for school_admin returns own school (id/code/name match), admin B gets own only (id!=A), principal can read (200), founder cannot use (403); PUT /api/my-school updates all whitelisted editable fields (name, principal_name, email, phone, website, board, academic_year, timings, working_days, city, state, pincode, address, description) - verified via GET after update; founder-controlled fields code/status/enabled_modules/subscription/plan are IGNORED (before/after values identical after PUT that includes them); principal PUT -> 403, founder PUT -> 403, empty payload -> 400, payload with only founder fields -> 400 (whitelist filter yields no updates); tenant isolation: admin cannot GET /api/schools (403), admin cannot PUT /api/schools/{other_id} or /api/schools/{own_id} via founder endpoint (403), school A and B fully isolated. Result: 14/14 PASS. Full regression 119/119 (backend_test 32 + founder_portal 28 + classroom 24 + parent_portal 21 + my_school 14) in 52.3s. Frontend Playwright: seeded fresh school+admin via API; login as school_admin -> /app; sidebar contains 'School Profile' link (nav item renders); navigated to /app/school-profile; locked bar shows original Code UI55434DB and Status active (set by platform); edited name/principal_name/address; clicked save-school-profile-button; page.reload() -> values persisted (Edited UI5 5434db / Principal UI5 / Playwright Lane 123); founder-view GET /api/schools/{id} confirms code unchanged from original. Screenshot matches expected layout - clean form, testids present, no console errors (only pre-login /auth/me 401 probe, expected).
critical_code_review_comments: routes_myschool.EDITABLE whitelist correctly excludes founder fields (code, status, enabled_modules, subscription, plan). Filter `{k: v for k, v in ... if v is not None and k in EDITABLE}` guarantees any client-supplied founder field is dropped server-side - solid defense.

school_id is derived from `user['school_id']` (session/JWT) never from request body/path - correct tenant scoping. Update query also enforces `status: {$ne: deleted}` preventing edits to deleted schools.
GET allowed for school_admin+principal via require_roles; PUT restricted to school_admin only via require_roles(ROLE_SCHOOL_ADMIN). Matches spec.
Audit log entry written after update with the list of changed field keys - good for traceability.

MINOR: PUT with only founder-controlled fields returns 400 'No valid fields to update'. Consider whether to log/audit this as a suspicious event (attempted privileged field change) - currently silently dropped without audit trail.

MINOR: Pydantic ProfileUpdate does not declare code/status/enabled_modules/subscription/plan, so Pydantic drops those keys before they reach EDITABLE filter - defense-in-depth is fine, but note that FastAPI 200s on unknown extra fields (default config). Explicit model_config with extra='ignore' would document intent.

MINOR: SchoolProfile.jsx save() sends `payload[k] = form[k] || ''` which converts undefined -> empty string. Since backend treats None as skip, empty string will overwrite server values with '' (e.g. clearing an unset website). If a user opens the page with some fields blank and saves, those fields get set to '' explicitly. Not a data loss risk today, but worth noting.
MINOR: SchoolProfile.jsx does not disable form during isLoading state on refetch - low impact.
OBSERVATION: No confirmation/dirty-state check before navigating away from unsaved edits. Nice-to-have.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (login, nav, GET/PUT round-trip, refresh persistence, locked-field display)
